systems.platform: built by a private vendor and handed to government in 2023, Treasury officials said
systems.owner: National Treasury, which runs it internally; draft regulations of 2026 would vest ownership, hosting and administration in it
systems.tiers: national government agencies would have to onboard within 12 months; county governments would have the option to join

note: Parliamentary scrutiny of draft regulations on the national services and payments portal, which counties may opt to join; nothing on the connection of county offices.
